content.text:
This figure is from AC 43.13-2B, Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices: Aircraft Alterations. Its caption: "FIGURE 9-16. TYPICAL BULKHEAD REINFORCEMENT INSTALLATION".
Describe it for a mechanic who can't see it: say what it shows, then transcribe every label,
value, unit, part number, and note printed in it. Don't add anything that isn't in the figure.
If it shows nothing of use (a logo, a signature, a blank area), say so in one sentence.

message.content:
The figure shows an exploded-view assembly of a typical bulkhead reinforcement installation, with a completed installation on the left and the individual components separated on the right.

Labels, values, units, part numbers, and notes printed in the figure:

- BULKHEAD
- REINFORCEMENT
- DOUBLER
- RIVETS
- BOLT
- NUT
- WASHER
- COTTER PIN
